title: Boundedness of the selected module derived tensor
statement: For commutative rings R and A, a ring map f : R →+* A, a strictly bounded-above complex C of A-modules supported above 0, and a bounded-above object N of D(R), the selected second-factor derived tensor functor applied to C sends N to a bounded-above object of D(A).

source.place: bounded-above flat resolution and derived tensor upper bound.

proof.text: Choose an upper-bounded representative and a bounded-above termwise flat quasi-isomorphic resolution. Apply the selected derived-tensor universal comparison on that K-flat resolution. The mixed tensor complex is strictly bounded above by the componentwise tensor support calculation; convert this to the derived t-structure bound and transport it across the resolution and counit isomorphisms.
